_comments: MJ: Archive Run Details.ArchiveRun is the related-name field for ArchiveRunID. It held the run's
StartedAt timestamp, so CodeGen's field categorization named it 'Archive Run Timestamp'. Since
Archive Runs is named by its ArchiveConfiguration instead (V202610190929__v6.2.x__Archive_StorageMode),
the field holds a configuration name, and CodeGen does not revisit a display name on a type change.
AutoUpdateDisplayName is turned off so the next categorization pass keeps this name.
